title: A Field in England
review: I realise now that I remembered the vibes and visuals from this film very well, but none of the plot. It looks incredibly striking, with great costuming and gritty historical accuracies. Black and white was a good choice, otherwise the whole thing would have been green and vivid, which wouldn't have matched the narrative tone. Even without colour the mushroom scenes here are better than those in {In the Earth}. The downside is that all the characters are grubby greyscale guys in soldier's garb, and it's a little hard to tell them all apart and follow the story. There are also some quick gore shots that might have been maximum grotesque, if we could have only seen them in true bloody colour. I guess we'll never know.
